case_title.quote: MARKASH JAJARA v. THE STATE OF ASSAM & ANR.

number_of_accused.quote: the appellant was held guilty of having committed the murder of his son-in-law

accused_gender.quote: the appellant just wanted to create some kind of psychological fear
accused_gender.reason: Accused is the father of the victim's wife, referred to as 'his'; male.

accused_socioeconomic_status.quote: owing to his poor financial conditions, the appellant's appeal was forwarded by the Jail Authorities

victim_gender.quote: his son-in-law, namely, late Markush Borja

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the deceased was living as a `ghar javai' with the appellant

offence_category.quote: falls within the expression of `culpable homicide' which does not amount to `murder'
offence_category.reason: Charged as murder, but the Supreme Court held it culpable homicide not amounting to murder.

statutory_provisions.quote: a chargesheet under Section 302 IPC was filed against him
statutory_provisions.reason: Only s.302 charged; Exception 1 to s.300 considered.

weapon.quote: assaulted and killed by the appellant with a bamboo stick

evidence_type.quote: The statement of the appellant's daughter ... has a direct and material bearing
evidence_type.reason: Matches confession, medical, circumstantial and non-eyewitness evidence.

confession.quote: he confessed before me that he had murdered my husband
confession.reason: Extra-judicial confession to PW-6, relied on by courts below.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: the injury sustained over the head by the deceased is fatal to cause instantaneous death
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Fatal head injuries noted; nothing else aggravating.

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: Sustained provocation by the victim's drinking and ill-treatment; loss of self-control; no pre-meditation; motive to protect daughter
mitigating_circumstances.quote: the appellant did not have any pre-meditated intention to commit the murder
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Poor financial condition was noted only for the jail appeal, not as mitigation.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Guilty under s.302 IPC; life imprisonment, fine Rs.10,000, six months' imprisonment on default
trial_court_outcome.quote: with the stipulated imprisonment of six months on default of payment of the fine amount
trial_court_outcome.reason: 'Simple' imprisonment is not stated in the judgment.

high_court_outcome.quote: The Gauhati High Court has dismissed the jail appeal

final_outcome.quote: The appeal is allowed in part.

offence_finally_established.quote: falls within the expression of `culpable homicide' which does not amount to `murder'
offence_finally_established.reason: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder.

fine_rs.quote: converting the sentence of life imprisonment awarded to the appellant to rigorous imprisonment of ten years
fine_rs.reason: Only the life term was converted; the Rs.10,000 fine was not set aside.

neutral_facts.reason: Accurate, neutral, without names or court proceedings.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment states no statutory punishment range.

physical_harm.quote: Laceration of size 7 cm x 1 cm ... right forehead

number_of_offences.reason: One section charged; modified conviction stands.

premeditation_planning.quote: the appellant did not have any pre-meditated intention to commit the murder

motive.quote: The appellant's motive at best was to prevent the deceased from misbehaving with his daughter

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the statement of P.W.6 - Sarani Boria needs to be appreciated in its entirety

witness_credibility.quote: This version deserves appreciation in its right perspective.

post_offence_conduct.quote: My father was also taken to the police station.
post_offence_conduct.reason: Confessed to daughter; taken to police station.

trial_duration.reason: Dates match; offence date not given.

legal_representation.quote: Gaurav Agrawal, Adv. for the Appellant.

investigation_status.quote: the appellant was arrested and a chargesheet under Section 302 IPC was filed

appeal_history.quote: The appeal is allowed in part.

defence_argument.quote: there was no eye witness to the occurrence and that the alleged confession ... could not be relied upon
defence_argument.reason: Accurately attributed to High Court stage.

legal_principle_applied.quote: Exception 1. —When culpable homicide is not murder.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Ajay Sing -Vs- State of Maharashtra reported in (2007) 12 sec 341
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Only the High Court's precedent is cited.

sentencing_rationale.quote: the ends of justice would be adequately met by converting the sentence

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: The series of provocative acts attributable to the deceased indeed laid the foundation of sustained provocation.

other_sentence_order.quote: The appellant shall be released on completion of the requisite and reduced period of sentence
